verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's spec page documents an 18-core Oryon CPU (12 Prime + 6 Performance) with up to 5.0 GHz boost on the Extreme variant, which covers the documented-specs half of the story. There is no independent multi-core benchmark in the pack: community comments note the launch showed no benchmarks and suggest waiting for independent reviews. Qualcomm also publishes no TDP figure, so sustained boost behavior under heavy parallel load is unknown. Missing for 10: independent multi-core or compile benchmarks, sustained/all-core boost behavior and power envelope (no TDP published), hands-on evidence of build or parallel-job performance.
